text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
The 'yakiniku party' to celebrate my 
birthday... It was a wonderful 
gathering...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
To rekindle an old friendship at a shop 
that truly understands my soul... It makes 
me genuinely happy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad you liked it♪ Picking that 
shop was definitely the right call.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ever since we frequented this place 
for our Victory Club wrap-up parties, it's 
been just as delicious as always...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, looks like we all ended up eating 
way too much again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally♪ —Wait, why do I feel 
strangely refreshed...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho... When it comes to dining... the 
"balance" of order and quantity is 
paramount...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Settle the gut, circulate the qi, and 
purge toxins— Follow this order without 
fail, and avoid overindulgence... Then 
even yakiniku can become... 'medicinal 
cuisine.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I left all the 
ordering to Chitose-chan's personal 
tastes, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, wasn't every single dish 
served at the exact right moment to give 
us just the energy we needed...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho... after this, the sweet nectar 
known as "V Cake" awaits us, after all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
I must 'prepare' myself... so I may savor 
it... deliciously... and healthily...
